newsitem.title: POLAND: Outlook unclear for Polish shares after gains.
newsitem.headline: Outlook unclear for Polish shares after gains.

text.p: The outlook for Polish shares was unclear and Friday's 1.8 percent rise of the WIG index to 13,932 points could either prompt profit-taking or renewed buying pressure, analysts said.
Some said they believed the market was strong enough to beat the July 5 record of 14,282.2 points as early as this week.
Others said that the stronger selling after price fixing on Friday signalled likely falls.
